title: The 4 Best Window Air Conditioners for Large Living Rooms
h1: The 4 Best Window Air Conditioners for Large Living Rooms
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for window air conditioners for large living rooms, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at window air conditioners for large living rooms using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: GE Profile ClearView 8,300 BTU Smart Window Air Conditioner AHTT08BC
products.blurb: Key specs: 8,300 BTU cooling capacity, the highest single-BTU figure here, Cools rooms up to 350 sq ft, Flex-depth frame fits 4.5 to nearly 14-inch-thick walls.
strengths: 8,300 BTU edges out the 8,000 BTU competitors here for genuinely large 300 to 350 sq ft rooms
Low-profile frame keeps more window visible in a room where the AC is on display all day
41 dB rating stays reasonable even during long afternoon and evening run times
No mounting bracket simplifies a living room installation that's often a wider, heavier window
limitations: 8,300 BTU still tops out at 350 sq ft; a true open floor plan will need the 12,200 BTU version
Flex-depth frame is bulkier to remove and store than a slim slide-in unit
features: 8,300 BTU cooling capacity, the highest single-BTU figure here
Cools rooms up to 350 sq ft
Flex-depth frame fits 4.5 to nearly 14-inch-thick walls
41 dB rated operation
SmartHQ Wi-Fi app, Alexa and Google Assistant

products.name: Midea 8,000 BTU U-Shaped Smart Inverter Window Air Conditioner
products.blurb: Key specs: 8,000 BTU inverter compressor, Cools rooms up to 350 sq ft, 37% more efficient than the federal minimum standard.
strengths: Inverter compressor uses less energy than a fixed-speed unit when it's running most of the day, which matters in a room people occupy from morning to night
37% efficiency gain over the federal standard adds up over a full cooling season in a heavily used room
Available in a 12,000 BTU U-shaped version for an open living-dining layout without switching brands
Quietest running unit in this list during long stretches of continuous use
limitations: Installation across the window sash takes longer than a standard slide-in unit
Midea's 2025 recall and repair program covers some early U-shaped units over a mold risk; verify status before buying used
8,000 BTU version is on the small side for a genuinely open-concept space
features: 8,000 BTU inverter compressor
Cools rooms up to 350 sq ft
37% more efficient than the federal minimum standard
U-shaped design routes noise outside the window
Also sold in a 12,000 BTU version for larger open spaces

products.name: LG 8,000 BTU Smart Window Air Conditioner LW8017ERSM1
products.blurb: Key specs: 8,000 BTU cooling capacity, Cools rooms up to 340 sq ft, LG ThinQ Wi-Fi app control.
strengths: Lowest typical price of the three 8,000 BTU units in this list
340 sq ft rating covers most single-room living rooms without stepping up in price
LG ThinQ app lets you start cooling before walking in from work
Straightforward washable filter access from the front panel
limitations: Fixed-speed compressor is louder at full cooling than the Midea's inverter over a long afternoon
No U-shaped or flex-depth frame, so it sits fully inside the window opening
340 sq ft rating is the lowest of the three 8,000-class units here
features: 8,000 BTU cooling capacity
Cools rooms up to 340 sq ft
LG ThinQ Wi-Fi app control
3 cooling and 3 fan speeds
Washable pre-filter

products.name: Frigidaire 8,000 BTU Smart Inverter Window Air Conditioner FHWW085WE1
products.blurb: Key specs: 8,000 BTU inverter compressor, Cools rooms up to 350 sq ft, 6-way directional airflow.
strengths: 6-way directional airflow throws cool air further across a wide living room than a fixed 2-way vent
Inverter compressor keeps noise reasonable during long afternoon sessions
PureAir washable filter is easy to pull and rinse without tools
350 sq ft rating matches the ClearView's coverage at a lower typical price
limitations: Fewer long-term owner reviews than the LG or Midea, so reliability data is thinner
42 dBA is the highest rated noise figure among the inverter units here
6-way vents add a learning curve for finding the best angle in a larger room
